title: The bug where my AI literally taught itself to be dramatic
author: jaofos

comments.author: oadephon
comments.body:
My game is full of Claude slop writing, too. I'm going to have to do a pass over every tooltip, headline, and piece of info text at some point to de-claudify it. 

I've seen this symptom in other games, too. Claude likes verbose language with a certain degree of flair, when human devs would use simple language with little flair 95% of the time.

Ultimately, imo, all text should be human-authored, even if Claude could get close with some instruction.

replies.author: jaofos
replies.body: I am not a writer, I am good at tweaking something written to be "my style", but I always work best and have my best ideals when I can see something written and iterate quickly.  AI really helps get this process flowing for me, I treat all text it writes as placeholders, and manually tweak it to be "me".  I just let it go a bit too far this time, which is a valuable lesson I think.
